————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, March 14, 2018/Phalguna 23, 1939 (Saka)

(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and

Total number of questions — 15
68
Sanctioned projects under Swadesh
Darshan Scheme
*196. SHRI A.K. SELV ARAJ: Will the
Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that eleven
projects have been sanctioned under
Swadesh Darshan Scheme in the year
2017-18 alone, taking the total number of
projects upto 67;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government's plan is for holistic
development of pilgrimage destinations
across the country, including Buddhist
Circuit; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of A.P. Reorganisation
Act
*197. DR. K.V .P. RAMACHANDRA
RAO: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Andhra
Pradesh has made several requests to the
Central Government for implementation of
several provisions made in A.P.
Reorganization Act, 2014 and assurances
given during the passing of A.P.
Reorganization Bill;
(b) if so, details thereof along with
reasons for not implementing provisions
of the Act;
(c) if not, what are the provisions fully
implemented by Government till now and
what are the provisions and assurances still
to be implemented; and
(d) by when the provisions/assurances
will be fulfilled completely?
Survey on habit of domestic tourists
*198. SHRI A. VIJAY AKUMAR: Will
the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has conducted
any survey on the habit of domestic tourists
in the country;

69
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether many of the domestic
tourists undertake visits in an unplanned
manner; and
(d) if so, whether any initiatives have
been taken to make Indian citizens
undertake tourism in a planned manner?
Crime in Delhi
*199. SHRIMATI KAHKASHAN
PERWEEN: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether crimes like vehicle thefts,
robbery, chain snatching, eve teasing, rape,
etc. in Delhi have increased from January
to March, 2018 in comparison to the
corresponding period of 2017;
(b) the number of cases in which
criminals could not be identified/arrested
during the year 2018;
(c) the action plan to make Delhi a safe
place for living;
(d) the ranking of Delhi based on crime
rate in the country; and
(e) the names of crime prone police
stations in Delhi showing increasing trend
and action taken against guilty officers for
dereliction of duty?
Steps taken to seal Assam-Bangladesh
border
*200. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken by Government to
seal and secure the Assam-Bangladesh
border;
(b) how many kilometres of the border
have been sealed so far; and
(c) the measures taken to secure the
unfenced portion of the border which
includes riverine areas?
Steel plant at Bayyaram
*201. SHRI DHARMAPURI
SRINIV AS: Will the Minister of STEEL
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the matter of establishment
of steel plant at Bayyaram, Khammam
district of Telangana which was a promise
made in the AP Reorganisation Act, if so,
the details thereof;
(b) whether Government of Telangana
has submitted a fresh proposal through its
IT Minister requesting the Ministry to
expedite the process of establishment of a
steel plant at Bayyaram in Telangana, if so,
the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has given any
assurance in this regard, if so, the details
thereof; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to speed up execution work
immediately?
Use of Hindi in official work
†*202. SHRIMATI CHHAY A
VERMA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
Departments find it difficult to work in
Hindi, which is the official language of
Union of India, and therefore maximum
work is being disposed of in English
language;
(b) whether Government has prepared
any framework under which all
Government Departments will start

70
working in official language Hindi in a
phased manner; and
(c) the steps taken by Government
Departments in the form of Hindi
Pakhwada every year to encourage working
in Hindi language during the last three
years and whether it has promoted working
in Hindi?
Recognising Andhra Natyam as a
classical dance
*203. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that artists,
political leaders and others have
approached Government to recognize the
traditional Andhra Natyam and to give it
the status of classical dance;
(b) if so, the details of the demand and
action taken by the Ministry in this regard;
and
(c) how much

Bilateral trade with countries
2081. SHRI SANJAY SETH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has signed bilateral
trade agreements with various countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof and salient
features of these agreements signed during
the last three years;
(c) whether India and Bangladesh had
held detailed discussions in Dhaka to boost
bilateral trade and investments recently;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether both the countries also
deliberated upon expansion of Border
Haats, identification and resolution of non-
tariff issues af fecting bilateral trade and
ease of investment;
(f) if so, the outcome thereof; and
(g) the other steps taken by Government
to boost trade between India and
Bangladesh?
 Progress made under 'Startup India'
programme
†2082. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the progress made
under ‘Startup India’ programme since its
inception;
(b) whether the existing funding
mechanism is adequate or Government
proposes to improve it; and
(c) the efforts made by Government for
adoption of uniform approach by the State
Governments to give required thrust to
Start-up schemes in the country?
 Mismatch in trade of agri-products
2083. SHRI K.C. RAMAMURTHY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) reasons for mismatch between
exports and imports of agricultural
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

490
products from the country since 2013-14
to last financial year;
(b) reasons for consistent reduction in
exports and steep increase in imports
during above period;
(c) the details of each of the factors
responsible for spurt in imports and
reduction in exports;
(d) the details of agricultural
commodities that are normally exported
and fluctuation of each of such product in
the international market during the above
period, month-wise and commodity-wise;
and
(e) what innovative methods are being
adopted by Commodity Boards such as
APEDA, MPEDA, Tobacco Board, Spices
Board, etc.?
 Expansion of e-commerce market
2084. SHRI K.C. RAMAMURTHY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry considers that
e-commerce market is growing in the
country at the desirable rate;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether instances of irregularities
in the functioning of e-commerce have
come to the notice of Government; and
(d) if so, the details of the remedial
action taken by Government to remove
such irregularities?
 Decision of WTO on India's agricultural
procurement programme
2085. SHRI DEREK O’BRIEN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the decisions taken in the WTO
Ministerial Conference in Buenos Aires
with respect to Government procurement
programmes in the farm sector, if any;
(b) the impact of such decisions on
India's agricultural procurement
programme;
(c) whether India's procurement
programmes in wheat and rice are affected
by existing WTO regulations;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether India's procurement
programmes in crops other than wheat and
rice are also affected by existing WTO
regulations; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
 Shifting of industries from Punjab
2086. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
many industries from Punjab have shifted
to neighbouring States because of
numerous incentives being given by States
like  Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh;
(b) whether Government has conducted
any survey in this regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) how Government proposes to help
industries of Punjab?
 Export target for tea
2087. SHRI N. GOKULA-
KRISHNAN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian tea

491
exports have touched a record high in
36 years at 240.7 million kg. in the year
2017, the previous high of 241.3 million
kg. having been achieved in the year 1981;
(b) whether it is also a fact that it seems
export target of 275 million kg. by 2020 is
possible;
(c) whether in several countries,
including the US, Indian teas were sold at
prices which were higher than the average
export price of US dollar three per kg.; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Import of cheap arecanut, pepper etc.
from Sri Lanka
2088. SHRI K.K. RAGESH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
